Saying this here cause 30 min timer is ass mods smh smh.

<@1487626955791663208> This was a very sour moment to post this bugfix considering it had existed since Corpo release. 

And now that both banners ran you bugfixed makes it even worse.

On the 1000th day of Morimens no less. Congratulations genuinely, glad it's living well. 
But with these ass bugfixes it can make people stop spending.

We have lily who still is missing half of her power from that bugfix (user Lens can give better info on that)

24 which I'm glad she got back what she lost. 

But now Corpo lost her synergy with a wheel which was with her ever since her debut. That bug should have been squashed in like the first month or less of her release not 1+ years.

Should have run some internal number tests to balance out the loss of shielding from that wheel and just slapped like +5% ratio or so on the shield and NOBODY would be mad.

It's annoying that this is repeating cycle and it does make people wary of over investing resources AND irl resources into units and meta wheels because if a combo of 1+ years can get bugfixed what's stopping a different hidden wheel x awakener tech get nerfed due to "bugfix"
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1170692781216378960/1541668133654372392/noname.gif
We love this game don't forget that

I just read the entire post, and I don't understand why the developers are nerfing older characters. How is this supposed to be “balanced” when, with every new update, the endgame and story content become more complicated to the point where you basically can't use characters from the permanent banner? If players have invested heavily in them, the developers should be implementing improvements for those characters so their kits adapt better to the updates, not making them even worse especially if it's a promotional character.

That's why I'm so confused.

It's a negative no matter how you slice it 

They should have checked if the nerf was huge and if it was, then adjust the scalings in Corpo herself so it's equal as if you had that bonus shield effect
Ez w
Devs lose out for nothing
